speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates

people-context-sdd.name: people-context SDD (RED→YELLOW→GREEN, máximo rigor)
people-context-sdd.description: Pipeline spec-driven do people-context: descoberta → SPEC → camadas/ports → ADRs → métricas → plano → BDD → TDD (RED) → implementação (YELLOW) → review → gate W3 (GREEN). Máximo rigor: cada fase consulta a persona-consultora ACDG (prompts MCP /acdg-skills:*), delega ao agente interno da camada, e decisões-chave (DDD, ADR, TDD, review) exigem citação canônica literal (≥4 linhas) via as tools skills_buscar/skills_citar.
